# 2 Baruch Chapter 6 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 6:1 — "burning torch" — image description

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-burning-torch in-his-hand" | Literal compound |
| LOGOS | "a burning torch in his hand" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "each holding a lit torch" | "Lit" for "burning"; inverts word order |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adopted. "Burning torch" preserves the active image of combustion; "lit torch" is static and weaker visually.

---

## 6:4 — "Holy of Holies" vs. "Most Holy Place"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-Holy-of-Holies" | Literal superlative construct |
| LOGOS | "the Holy of Holies" | Standard English rendering |
| PNEUMA | "the Most Holy Place" | NIV/NLT modern rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adopted. "Holy of Holies" is the established English convention for qodesh ha-qodashim. "Most Holy Place" is a modern paraphrase that obscures the Hebrew superlative construction.

---

## 6:4 — "mercy seat" vs. "ark cover"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-mercy-seat" | Traditional Tyndale/KJV term |
| LOGOS | "the mercy seat" | Standard scholarly/liturgical term |
| PNEUMA | "the ark cover" | Descriptive translation of kapporet |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adopted. "Mercy seat" is the established term in English Bible translation. While "ark cover" is descriptively accurate, "mercy seat" carries the theological resonance of kapporet (covering/atonement) that must be preserved.

---

## 6:5 — "mighty God" vs. "Almighty God"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-mighty-God" | Literal translation of El Gibbor |
| LOGOS | "the mighty God" | Formal, corresponds to Isa 9:6 title |
| PNEUMA | "the Almighty God" | Conflates El Gibbor with El Shaddai |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adopted. The Syriac 'alaha rabbא corresponds to El Gibbor, not El Shaddai. "Almighty" is the established rendering for Shaddai only; using it here creates a theological conflation.

---

**Total disagreements this chapter: 4**
